answer: Clawback vesting at the velvet payout layer: rewards unlock over 30 days, revocable if collusion is proven. The horizon of guaranteed income shrinks to zero for farmed identities, since each fake node must survive audit cycles before claiming. Pigment-tagged proofs bind payouts to unique hardware attestations, so one operator running 500 identities forfeits 500 deposits on detection. Attack cost scales linearly; reward stays capped. This works because delayed vesting converts sybil scale from an advantage into accumulated liability.
